verdict.rationale: RustDesk ships a Server Pro management API and self-hosted servers, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or dry-run environment isolated from production data. Self-hosting a separate server would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
